messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: Elevated 5xx rate observed originating from CloudWatch Logs egress in us-east-1. Affected: Hosted API endpoints and Dedicated pools in the region. Auto-pager triggered.
ops-oncall: paging @cheng (oncall). please acknowledge.
cheng: ack, taking. pulling metrics and traces now.
maria: seeing spike on hosted-api-us-east-1 route: 5xx+latency start ~13:18 UTC, error rate ~18% at peak.
sam: Dedicated pool us-east-1 nodes reporting longer token latencies and occasional 503s, backlog increasing.
cheng: traced to cw-logs-egress DNS / TLS failures hitting our egress proxies; some STS calls returning 503 from cw-logs-ingest.amazonaws.com.
ops-oncall: @pagerduty escalate to SRE lead if impact widens.
sre-lead: joining. is this regional only? any cross-region failover in place?
maria: yes region-localized; we have routing policies but many customers are pinned to us-east-1.
cheng: quick check: `curl -v https://cw-logs-ingest.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/health` -> connection reset / 503. repeating from multiple NATs.
sam: mitigation options: (1) reroute control-plane egress to us-east-2 via egress-bypass, (2) fallback to cached model variants in Dedicated pools to reduce dependency egress, (3) throttle retries.
ops-oncall: prioritize (1) + (3) short-term. execute and monitor.
cheng: starting canary reroute for control-plane egress (10% traffic -> us-east-2) at 13:24 UTC.
maria: drafting status page update: 'Partial service degradation in us-east-1, we are routing around a third-party outage.' will post after confirmation.
sam: applied retry limiter at edge to cap client retry storms. reducing pressure on egress.
ops-oncall: notify CS for customers pinned to us-east-1; @natalie can you coordinate outreach for top 5 customers?
natalie: on it, gathering affected tenant list and severity.
cheng: canary reroute looks good, error rate down to ~6% in canary group. rolling to 50% now.
sre-lead: monitoring Dedicated pools queue and model latency. consider temporary scaling for workload if backlog persists.
sam: toggled fallback models for heavy queues; this reduces per-token compute and lowers latency for impacted Dedicated tenants.
maria: status page posted. tagging impacted tenants and ETA: updates every 15m.
ops-oncall: once stable for 20m, plan to remove reroute and revert retry limit to normal. ensure AWS reports cleared.
cheng: holding oncall. next update 13:40 UTC or sooner.
(13:39) incident-bot: AWS reported recovery for CloudWatch Logs egress in us-east-1.
cheng: starting rollback of canary reroute at 13:40 UTC, monitoring.
sam: removing temporary model fallback after confirming token latencies normalizing.
maria: final check: 12 tenants had elevated latency, 3 tenants experienced 5xxs. CS outreach in progress.
sre-lead: closing pager in 10m if no regression. please file a postmortem and assign to cheng + sam for remediation and runbook updates.
ops-oncall: noted. scheduling postmortem.
cheng: will draft postmortem, include playbook for egress chain failures and automated reroute runbook.
maria: thanks everyone — great coordination :thumbsup:
